Ads.description: Rewarded videos and interstitials. An interstitial shows only when both the level and time rules allow it.

rewarded_ads_per_day.description: Helper videos per day (cat and grandma combined). 0 turns them off. Default 3, allowed 0-20.

cat_hints_per_ad.description: Cat hints one video gives. Default 3, allowed 1-10.

grandmas_per_ad.description: Grandma helpers one video gives. Default 1, allowed 1-5.

ad_break_first_level.description: Interstitials can start after this level. Default 10, allowed 1-1000.

ad_break_levels_between.description: Levels passed between two interstitials. Default 2, allowed 1-50.

ad_break_min_seconds.description: Least seconds between two interstitials. Default 180, allowed 0-3600.

ad_break_seconds_after_rewarded.description: No interstitial this many seconds after a rewarded video. Default 120, allowed 0-3600.

Scoring.description: Shares of correct letters, written 0-1. Applied as a group: they must step down (3 balls >= 2 >= 1), or all keep their defaults.

pass_threshold.description: Share needed to pass a level. Default 0.8, allowed 0-1.

three_ball_threshold.description: Share needed for 3 yarn balls. Default 1.0, allowed 0-1.

two_ball_threshold.description: Share needed for 2 yarn balls. Default 0.9, allowed 0-1.

one_ball_threshold.description: Share needed for 1 yarn ball. Default 0.8, allowed 0-1.

Daily jar.description: The jar collected once a day on a 7-day calendar. Hint min and max are a group.

jar_grandma_chance.description: Chance an ordinary day's jar holds a grandma instead of cat hints. Default 0.25, allowed 0-1.

jar_hints_min.description: Fewest cat hints in an ordinary day's jar. Default 1, allowed 1-10.

jar_hints_max.description: Most cat hints in an ordinary day's jar. Default 3, allowed 1-10.

jar_big_reward_hints.description: Cat hints in the day-7 jar and a finished set's jar. Default 3, allowed 0-20.

jar_big_reward_grandmas.description: Grandma helpers in the day-7 jar and a finished set's jar. Default 1, allowed 0-5.

Prompts.description: When the rating prompt and grandma's reminder question may appear.

review_min_levels.description: Levels passed before the App Store rating prompt may be asked for. Default 5, allowed 1-500.

reminder_ask_min_levels.description: Levels passed before grandma asks about reminders. Default 3, allowed 1-100.
